name: Abacus
rule: +2 mult per chow.
icon: a wooden suanpan abacus standing upright, a dark frame, one crossbar, five columns of round beads.

name: Red String
rule: +6 mult.
icon: a red Chinese knot, a diamond-shaped weave with two short tails hanging below.

name: Coin String
rule: +50 chips.
icon: a short string of square-holed bronze cash coins threaded on a red cord, hanging in a curve.

name: Bamboo Grove
rule: +12 chips per scored Bamboo tile.
icon: a small round pot holding three bamboo stems with a few leaves.

name: Coin Purse
rule: +12 chips per scored Dots tile.
icon: a round embroidered silk purse with a drawstring top and a simple coin shape on its side.

name: Scroll
rule: +12 chips per scored Characters tile.
icon: a hand scroll partly unrolled, blank, with wooden rollers at each end.

name: Nest
rule: +6 mult per pair.
icon: a woven twig nest holding two speckled eggs.

name: Gold Toad
rule: +$4 after a won round, before a shop.
icon: the three-legged money toad sitting on a little heap of square-holed coins, one coin in its mouth.

name: Bell Hall
rule: ×2 with at least two pongs or kongs.
icon: three identical bronze bells hanging in a row from a small wooden frame.

name: Moon Gate
rule: +4 mult per non-single set containing a 1, 9 or wind.
icon: a round moon gate in a short length of white garden wall, seen straight on.

name: Iron Teapot
rule: +2 discards each round.
icon: a squat cast-iron teapot with a round lid knob and a curved spout.

name: Long Sleeves
rule: +1 hand size.
icon: a folded silk robe with very long sleeves draped over a stand.

name: Lantern
rule: See one more tile below every stack top.
icon: a round red silk lantern with gold caps top and bottom and a short gold tassel.

name: Mahjong!
rule: ×2 with four non-pair, non-single sets and at least one pair.
icon: a neat stack of four blank mahjong tiles with a pair of dice in front.

name: Two Fish
rule: ×1.5 when a non-empty table uses at most two numbered suits; winds do not add a suit.
icon: two fish curled head to tail in a circle.

name: Rice Bowl
rule: ×2 on a non-empty table without 1s, 9s or winds.
icon: a plain rice bowl with a pair of chopsticks resting across its rim.

name: Nine Rings
rule: ×3 with chows 123, 456 and 789 in the same suit.
icon: the nine linked rings puzzle: nine metal rings on a long bar with a loop handle.

name: Night Owl
rule: +1 play each round.
icon: a small round owl figurine with big round eyes, a crescent moon behind it.

name: Great Bell
rule: ×2 per kong, multiplicatively.
icon: one large bronze temple bell with rows of round knobs and a dragon-shaped loop on top.

name: Wind Chime
rule: +12 mult per Four Winds set or wind pong/kong. Wind pairs do not count.
icon: a glass wind chime with a cream bell and a long blank paper strip below.

name: Twin Cranes
rule: ×1.5 per disjoint pair of identical non-single sets.
icon: two red-crowned cranes standing side by side, necks crossing.

name: Three Treasures
rule: ×1.5 per pong; kongs do not count.
icon: three identical gold ingots (boat-shaped sycee) stacked in a small pyramid.

name: Stone Lion
rule: +3 mult per tile in a pong or kong.
icon: a small stone guardian lion sitting with one paw on a ball.

name: Odd Beads
rule: +7 chips per odd-ranked numbered tile.
icon: Five large beads on a curved string.

name: Even Comb
rule: +1 mult per even-ranked numbered tile.
icon: A broad comb with four thick teeth.

name: Little Steps
rule: +9 chips per numbered tile ranked 1–3.
icon: Three ascending stone steps.

name: High Peaks
rule: +9 chips per numbered tile ranked 7–9.
icon: Three tall angular mountain peaks.

name: Middle Path
rule: +1 mult per numbered tile ranked 4–6.
icon: A winding path between two low rocks.

name: Five Lanterns
rule: +2 mult per owned dragon, including this one.
icon: Five small lanterns hanging from one curved pole.

name: Closed Fan
rule: +25 chips per unused discard.
icon: One tightly closed folding fan.

name: Paper Fan
rule: +3 mult per unused discard.
icon: A fully open fan with three broad panels.
inspiration: Banner: saved discards, translated to mult

name: Jade Ox
rule: +3 chips per dollar held, counting at most $40.
icon: A sturdy jade ox in side profile.

name: Coin Belt
rule: +2 mult per complete $5 held, counting at most eight groups.
icon: A horizontal buckled belt with two coin studs.

name: Empty Chair
rule: ×(1 + 0.25 per empty dragon slot). Five slots total.
icon: An empty wooden chair with a high back.

name: Last Ember
rule: ×1.75 only when no plays remain. Banking early does not activate it.
icon: A single red ember inside a black brazier.

name: Still Pond
rule: ×1.75 if no discard action was used this round.
icon: A broad pond oval with one motionless lotus leaf.

name: First Echo
rule: Add the first tabled set’s base and tile chips once more, including its level. No mult, enhancements or dragon effects repeat.
icon: Two nested shell silhouettes facing the same way.

name: Pair Bridge
rule: ×1.75 with at least three pairs.
icon: A small bridge supported by three paired pillars.

name: Chow Drum
rule: +18 chips per chow.
icon: A round drum with three diagonal bands.

name: Pong Seal
rule: +35 chips per pong or kong.
icon: A square seal stamp with three chunky ridges.

name: Wind Sail
rule: +15 chips per scored wind tile.
icon: A triangular sail bowed by the wind.

name: East Compass
rule: +2 mult per scored wind matching this round’s direction (East, South, West, North).
icon: A round compass with one large right-pointing needle.

name: Rainbow Bridge
rule: ×2.5 with the same chow ranks in all three suits.
icon: A three-band arch resting on two clouds.

name: Three Brothers
rule: ×3 with pongs or kongs of the same numbered rank in all three suits.
icon: Three stout upright gourds joined by one cord.

name: Silk Banner
rule: ×2.5 when every scored tile belongs to one numbered suit; no winds.
icon: One broad vertical silk banner on a short pole.

name: Nine Windows
rule: ×2 when all nine numbered ranks occur on the table, across any suits.
icon: A square lattice window with nine open panes.

name: Gate Guardians
rule: +20 chips per scored 1 or 9; winds do not count.
icon: Two square gate posts with broad capstones.

name: Balanced Scales
rule: ×2 when each numbered suit has at least three scored tiles and all three counts are equal. Winds are ignored.
icon: A balance with three equal bowls on a triangular frame.

name: Four Tools
rule: +3 mult per distinct non-single set type on the table.
icon: A brush, mallet, comb and spoon arranged in a fan.

name: Quiet Scholar
rule: +2 mult per total set level gained, capped at ten levels.
icon: A closed book with a large ribbon bookmark.

name: Small Garden
rule: +0.5 mult per tile by which the current deck is below 81 tiles, capped at 24 tiles.
icon: A tiny square garden with one pruned tree.

name: Full Granary
rule: +5 chips per tile by which the current deck exceeds 81, capped at 24 tiles.
icon: A broad grain basket piled above its rim.

name: Dawn Rooster
rule: +2/+4/+6/+8 mult in East/South/West/North.
icon: A rooster standing on a low rising sun.

name: Pair Peddler
rule: +$1 per pair after a won round before a shop, capped at $5.
icon: A shoulder pole holding two small baskets.

name: Kong Mint
rule: +$4 per kong after a won round before a shop, capped at two kongs.
icon: Four coins emerging from a square mould.

name: Wind Courier
rule: +$3 per wind set after a won round before a shop, capped at two sets.
icon: A tied letter carried by a broad wing.

name: Tea Ledger
rule: +$5 after a won round before a shop if no discard was used.
icon: A small ledger beside a single tea cup.

name: Spare Cup
rule: +$1 per empty dragon slot after a won round before a shop, capped at $3.
icon: One empty cup beside a simple saucer.

name: Twin Peaches
rule: +6 mult per disjoint pair of identical non-single sets.
icon: Two large peaches joined by a short stem.

name: Fourth Pillar
rule: +100 chips per kong.
icon: Four square pillars supporting one heavy lintel.
